params.body:
## What

`/singleshowroom/{dealer_id}/{vehicle_id}` was a public, unauthenticated route. It decoded
both ids as plain base64 and rendered a slide for the vehicle with its make, model and retail
price, without checking whether the vehicle was published, unsold or in the dealer's showroom
selection. The ids run in sequence, so every vehicle of every dealer could be enumerated from
it. Replayed on 26 October 2026: a sold, unpublished, unfinished vehicle came back with status
200 and its retail price.

A visitor without a login is meant to see only what a dealer published: the website (R S2-5.2)
and the showroom selection (R S2-7.6). This route showed everything.

The route existed only as the page a headless Chrome photographed for "Download showroom".
Since 16 September 2026 the download draws each slide in PHP (`App\Support\ShowroomSlide`,
R S2-7.16), so nothing links to it any more.

## Change

- Remove the route `home.index.singleshowroomimage` and `SettingsController::singleShowroomImage`.
- Remove the orphaned wrapper view `ownstock/showroom_single_vehicles.blade.php`. The slide
  markup lives in `ownstock/showroom_vehicle.blade.php`, which the carousel still includes; the
  `eager` branch there had no other caller, so it collapses to the lazy path the carousel wants.
- Drop `singleshowroom/*` from `FrameHeaders` and `Disallow: /singleshowroom/` from
  `robots.txt`: both guarded a page that no longer exists.
- Rules: R S2-7.6 and R P3-3.11 no longer name the path; R S2-7.11, which described the old
  screenshot behaviour, lapses to `vervallen`, superseded by R S2-7.16.

Fixes bevinding singleshowroom-toont-elke-wagen.

## Tests

- `ShowroomTest`, `FrameHeadersTest`, `ShowroomScreenIsNotIndexedTest` and `SmokeTest` drop the
  cases that drove the removed route; `the_carousel_keeps_the_photo_lazy` still passes, so the
  public showroom is unchanged.
- `RulesSourcesTest` and `RulesIdentityTest` confirm the rule and finding edits are consistent.
- Full suite green on a fresh database.
params.title: Remove the public /singleshowroom route that rendered any vehicle
